Tevon Talbert Sr.

At just 31 years old, Tevon Talbert has already embarked on an inspiring journey in the world of software engineering. Born and raised in Alton, Illinois, Tevon’s passion for technology started at a young age. What began as a fascination with computers has grown into a thriving career in Java full-stack development. Growing up in a small town, Tevon didn’t have immediate access to big-city tech resources, but he was determined to learn. His journey started with online courses and tutorials, where he taught himself the fundamentals of coding. Tevon’s curiosity and persistence led him to dive deep into the world of Java development, and through hard work and dedication, he made his dream of becoming a developer a reality. Today, Tevon is a Junior Developer specializing in Java full-stack development. His skills span across both front-end and back-end technologies, allowing him to create dynamic and scalable web applications that serve users' needs in various industries. From designing responsive user interfaces to developing robust server-side systems, Tevon is passionate about building solutions that have a real-world impact. Despite the challenges that come with being a self-taught developer in a constantly evolving industry, Tevon has managed to push past the obstacles and has found success through his relentless determination. His journey wasn’t without its ups and downs—there were moments when doubt crept in—but Tevon’s love for coding and his belief in his potential kept him going. Tevon is committed to lifelong learning, constantly refining his skills, and staying up-to-date with the latest trends in software development. As a Junior Developer, he actively participates in developer communities, collaborates with fellow programmers, and contributes to open-source projects. He believes in the power of community and is dedicated to supporting other aspiring developers in their own journeys. Living and working in Alton, Illinois, Tevon is a testament to the idea that you don’t have to be in Silicon Valley to make an impact in the tech world. He hopes to continue advancing in his career, work on innovative projects, and inspire the next generation of developers in small towns like his own. Tevon’s motto is simple: “Hard work, perseverance, and a love for what you do can turn any challenge into an opportunity.”
